title: 4 蹲步起伏身若奔马一5 蹲步起伏身若奔马二
content_zh:
金东街33号。
这是个大庭院，比林哲羽租住的地方大了一倍不止。
从外头看，房子建的很精致，价格应该很贵，就是不知道梁师傅是租的还是买的。
咚咚
咚咚咚
林哲羽有规律地敲门。
没敲多久，门吱吖一声开了。
梁松跛着脚走来开门，转身继续回去浇花。
院子里种满了紫色的花，空气中萦绕着一股沁人心鼻的芳香，很好闻。
植株叶片碧绿青翠，花形大而奇，宛若翩翩彩蝶，花色丰富，很好看。
“不要动，自己随意找个地方坐着。”
就在林哲羽积极地要上前帮忙浇花时，梁松出声制止了。
他很宝贵这些花，不想让不懂花的林哲羽伤害到它们。
林哲羽默默坐在庭院里的石桌旁。
梁师傅浇花浇了半个多时辰，这才心满意足地走到林哲羽旁的位置坐下。
他走路一跛一跛的，看起来像是個不修边幅的老头，没有丝毫武道高手的气质风范。
“不用那么拘谨，放松些。”
“还拿了肉过来，有心了。”
“在我这儿不流行拜师礼，再说我还没打算收你作为徒弟。”
梁松瞥了眼桌上林哲羽带来的东西笑着说道。

他也只是一时兴起，打算教些浅显的武艺，能够学几分，就看林哲羽的悟性了。
林哲羽露出一抹微笑，也不说话，拿起桌上泡好的茶水，乖巧地给梁松倒了一杯。
“习武看的是悟性、毅力、还有资源。”
“你的身体基础太差了，需要养一阵子才行。”
梁松接过林哲羽递过来的茶水，吃着林哲羽带过来的点心，饶有兴趣说道。
他很喜欢林哲羽说的那些故事，挺有意思的，故事中的很多人物都很合他的胃口。
就是书生意气过重，故事里的主人公都是书生。优柔寡断，听着腻歪。
要他说的话，让燕赤霞做主人公才是正理。
“嗯嗯，最近挣了些钱，已经在养身子了。”林哲羽点点头道。
“还不够，养身子既要吃，也要练。”
梁松淡淡说道：“你的根基很差，没有接触过武艺，平时也不怎么锻炼，腰腿和脚都是稀的。”
content_en:
No. 33, Jindong Street.
This is a large courtyard, more than twice the size of the place where Lin Zheyu rents.
From the outside, the house looks very exquisite and the price should be very expensive, but I don’t know whether Master Liang rented it or bought it.
dong dong
dong dong dong
Lin Zheyu knocked on the door regularly.
Not long after knocking, the door creaked open.
Liang Song lamely walked to open the door, turned around and went back to water the flowers.
The yard is full of purple flowers, and there is a refreshing fragrance lingering in the air, which smells good.
The leaves of the plant are green and verdant, and the flowers are large and strange in shape, just like fluttering butterflies. The flowers are rich in color and very beautiful.
"Don't move, just find a place to sit."
Just when Lin Zheyu actively wanted to step forward to help water the flowers, Liang Song stopped him.
He valued these flowers and did not want Lin Zheyu, who did not understand flowers, to harm them.
Lin Zheyu sat silently at the stone table in the courtyard.
Master Liang watered the flowers for more than half an hour, and then he walked to the seat next to Lin Zheyu and sat down with satisfaction.
He walked with a limp and looked like a slovenly old man, without any trace of the temperament of a martial arts master.
"Don't be so formal, just relax."
"I even brought some meat over, so I'm very thoughtful."
"Apprenticeship is not popular here, and besides, I have no plans to accept you as my apprentice."
Liang Song glanced at the things Lin Zheyu brought on the table and said with a smile.
He just wanted to teach some simple martial arts on a whim. How much he can learn depends on Lin Zheyu's understanding.
Lin Zheyu smiled and said nothing. He picked up the tea brewed on the table and poured a cup for Liang Song obediently.
“Martial arts practice depends on understanding, perseverance, and resources.”
"Your physical foundation is too weak and you need to take care of yourself for a while."
Liang Song took the tea from Lin Zheyu, ate the snacks that Lin Zheyu brought, and said with interest.
He liked the stories Lin Zheyu told very much. They were quite interesting and many of the characters in the stories suited his taste.
It’s just that the scholarly spirit is too strong, and the protagonists in the story are all scholars. Indecisive, it sounds annoying.
If he had to say it, it would be right to let Yan Chixia be the protagonist.
"Yeah, I've made some money recently and am already taking care of myself." Lin Zheyu nodded.
"That's not enough. To maintain your body, you need to eat as well as exercise."
Liang Song said calmly: "Your foundation is very poor. You have never been exposed to martial arts. You don't exercise much. Your waist, legs and feet are thin."
